key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Cychwyn cyflym
 1. Gosodwch Torque Pro (y fersiwn taledig; nid yw Torque Lite yn cynnal ategion) a phârwyoch yr addasydd OBD-II.
 2. Galluogwch yr ategyn hwn yn Torque → Gosodiadau → Ategion.
 3. Caniatewch hysbysiadau a gosodwch ddefnydd batri i Ddigyfyngiad fel y gall Torque gychwyn yr ategyn hwn yn y cefndir.
 4. Yn Torque, dewiswch broffil y cerbyd rydych yn ei yrru. Cedwir data fesul proffil Torque a'i wirio yn erbyn hunaniaeth VIN/ECU y cerbyd.
 5. Ar broffil newydd canfyddir ffynhonnell y tanwydd wrth gysylltu; os gofynnir, cymharwch hi â mesurydd y dangosfwrdd a thapio Cadarnhau. Mae Cadarnhau ar y dudalen gosod ac yn yr hysbysiad. Gallwch ei ddewis isod hefyd.
 6. Nid oes maint tanc i'w roi yma. Mae pob ffitiad yn dysgu ei faint ei hun, a ddangosir o dan Maint tanc a ddysgwyd; tan hynny mae ei ganran wedi'i chywiro yn darllen 1:1 gyda'r mesurydd. Rhowch faint y tanc ym mhroffil cerbyd Torque ar gyfer tanwydd sy'n weddill a DTE Torque ei hun.
 7. Yn Torque, ychwanegwch fesuryddion ar gyfer [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level ac, ar gyfer pob ffitiad, Corrected % a Tank size. Nid yw'r ategyn yn cyhoeddi tanwydd sy'n weddill nac DTE. Dywed hysbysiad yn ystod ailffitio fod y ffitiad yn darllen 1:1 nes i'r ailffitio orffen.
 8. Anfonwch lefel y tanwydd yn ôl i Torque: I ffwrdd, llyfn, neu wedi'i gywiro o ffitiad Chunk, Band neu Kalman, ar eich mesurydd 012F. Yna mae tanwydd sy'n weddill a DTE Torque ei hun yn defnyddio'r lefel honno gyda maint y tanc a'r mpg hirdymor ym mhroffil Torque.
 9. Dim ond tra bo'r injan yn rhedeg y cyfrifir tanwydd. Dim ond tra bo Torque wedi'i gysylltu â'r ECU y mae'r ategyn yn rhedeg.
 10. Daliwch ati i yrru ac i lenwi; mae cywirdeb yn tyfu dros sawl tanc rhannol. Os na all yr ategyn ddweud pa gerbyd yw hwn, mae'n gofyn mewn hysbysiad ac ar y dudalen hon; dewiswch beth i'w wneud â'r daith honno.
 11. Mae'r holl ddata'n aros ar y ffôn hwn. Ni chofnodir GPS na lleoliad.
